notes: Moved *who* (t013) from `γνωστός` to the third attributive article `ὁ` (s015), which is now `aligned` rather than `unrepresented`, because rule 31 leaves the relativizer with the article when the modifier is an adjective rather than a participle and rule 53 gives the predicate adjective only the copula; the rest of the verse was already right.
